content.short_description: Aliens vs. Predator: Extinction (2003) - A poorly-received title with fundamental design issues that prevented critical success.
content.reviewer_notes: Total 90/100; strongest pillar is values, with accessibility as the main score limiter.
content.values_findings: Aliens vs. Predator: Extinction exemplifies responsible monetization with premium pricing and zero exploitative mechanics. Launched at $49.99. No day-one microtransactions. No loot boxes or randomized paid rewards.
content.ethics_findings: Aliens vs. Predator: Extinction demonstrates strong ethical practices including honest marketing and good post-launch support. Announced well ahead of 2003 release. Post-launch support sustained.
content.gameplay_findings: Aliens vs. Predator: Extinction provides exceptional gameplay depth with substantial campaign and multiple meaningful outcomes. Designed as single-player experience. Multiplayer features added post-launch. Multiple endings reward different playstyles.
content.accessibility_findings: Aliens vs. Predator: Extinction provides comprehensive accessibility including multiple control schemes and localization. Multi-language localization included.
content.standards_findings: Aliens vs. Predator: Extinction achieves solid technical quality with good launch reception and feature completeness. Fully offline-playable campaign. Legacy release exemption applied (pre-2010).

content.short_description: A hard-edged arcade brawler with excellent feel and presentation, scored conservatively for short runtime and limited long-tail support.
content.reviewer_notes: Total 63/100; strongest pillar score is accessibility, with the largest drag from gameplay.
content.values_findings: Final Vendetta  maintains strong consumer ethics through fair pricing and minimal monetization. Launched at $24.95. No day-one microtransactions. No loot boxes or randomized paid rewards.
content.ethics_findings: Final Vendetta  demonstrates significant ethical issues including broken promises or poor support. Announced well ahead of 2022 release. Post-launch support sustained.
content.gameplay_findings: Final Vendetta  provides limited gameplay variety or short campaign. Designed as single-player experience. Multiplayer features added post-launch. Multiple endings reward different playstyles.
content.accessibility_findings: Final Vendetta  provides comprehensive accessibility including multiple control schemes and localization. Multi-language localization included.
content.standards_findings: Final Vendetta  achieves solid technical quality with good launch reception and feature completeness. Fully offline-playable campaign. Legacy release exemption applied (pre-2010).
